children: TransMedics appointed Fernando Araujo to be its next chief financial officer, effective Sept. 21.

He is expected to succeed Gerardo Hernandez, who would move into the position of commercial strategic advisor for LATAM, where he would lead the company's expansion into Latin America, the company said Thursday.

Arajuo was most recently financial chief of GE HealthCare's Advanced Imaging Solutions unit, a $16 billion segment combining its imaging and advanced visualization solutions businesses with its global integrated supply chain and global service organizations. He also held a series of other financial chief roles during his 17 years at GE, the company said.

Andover, Mass.-based TransMedics also reiterated its revenue guidance for this year of $737 million to $757 million. That represents year-over-year growth of 22% to 25%, the company said. For 2025, the company recorded revenue of $605.5 million.
Wall Street is expecting revenue of $743.1 million this year, according to FactSet.
TransMedics describes itself as a global leader in the portable warm perfusion for donor organs for transplantation.
